# Double Per Passenger coverage for Aviation accounts


## What Sets Kinsale’s Aviation Division Apart:


#### **Excess sublimits to match your accounts’ primary per passenger sublimits**


#### **Customizable Aircraft Hull & Liability solutions on a primary, excess, or quota share basis**


#### **Industry-leading turnaround & dedicated underwriters**


When you submit accounts with existing primary Per Passenger sublimits to our[Aviation Division](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/transportation/aviation-air-operations/) , Kinsale can match those sublimits with our excess options, doubling the Per Passenger coverage.


---


## Here’s How It Works:


Say a client’s primary policy includes a Per Passenger sublimit of $250,000, and the current carrier is not willing to offer more coverage. Kinsale’s excess coverage can match that same number dollar for dollar, bringing total Per Passenger coverage to $500,000. In many cases, Kinsale can consider the desired limits on a primary basis, eliminating the need for multiple policies.


Submit accounts with existing primary per passenger sublimits to our[Aviation Division](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/transportation/aviation-air-operations/) . We’ll work with you to build an extra layer of protection, closing coverage gaps and providing peace of mind for flying clubs, private business, recreational, corporate, and commercial accounts.


Submit Your Aviation Account

**Explore the Potential** for all your Aviation accounts at Kinsale. Our consistent Aviation appetite targets hard-to-insure general aviation accounts, including options for[Ground Operations](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/transportation/aviation-ground-operations/) and[UAS/Drone Operations](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/transportation/aviation-uas-drone-operations/) on an excess or quota share basis.
